name: Badger Infrastructure Solutions Ltd.
summary: Badger Infrastructure Solutions Ltd. provides non-destructive excavating and related services to utilities, industrial, construction, transportation, and other industries in Canada and the United States. It offers Badger Hydrovac for use in safe excavations around critical infrastructure and in congested underground conditions.
